title: The Security Cost of Robustness: code and results
description: Code, patches and result files for the paper The Security Cost of Robustness: Measuring Robust JPEG Steganography on Two Recompression Channels. It evaluates GMAS, ROAST, MINICER, SCRIPT and J-UNIWARD on one protocol (10,000 BOSSbase images, DCTR + FLD, EfficientNet-B0 and SRNet) on two recompression channels. The tables of the paper are rebuilt from the included result files. The reference implementations are not redistributed; our changes to them ship as patches against commit f1765807 of https://github.com/coriverchen/Robust_Steganography.
